title: Snake wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#7ee87e'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2fae4a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='belly' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f6ff9e'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#cfe86a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lens' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#4a4a6a'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#1e1e3a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#12122a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- coiled tail body -->
  <path d='M18 88 C10 88 8 78 16 76 C30 72 52 78 66 74 C80 70 82 60 72 58 C60 56 46 64 36 62 C26 60 26 50 38 48'
        fill='none' stroke='url(#body)' stroke-width='13' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M18 88 C10 88 8 78 16 76 C30 72 52 78 66 74 C80 70 82 60 72 58 C60 56 46 64 36 62 C26 60 26 50 38 48'
        fill='none' stroke='url(#belly)' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- rising neck -->
  <path d='M38 48 C44 40 46 34 48 28' fill='none' stroke='url(#body)' stroke-width='13' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='24' rx='20' ry='14' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='30' rx='14' ry='6' fill='url(#belly)' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- tongue -->
  <path d='M70 27 L80 29 L76 27 L80 25' fill='none' stroke='#ff5a8a' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <path d='M34 20 L38 16 C44 14 50 14 54 16 L54 22 C50 20 44 20 40 22 Z' fill='url(#lens)'/>
  <path d='M56 16 C62 14 68 14 72 17 L70 23 C66 21 60 21 56 22 Z' fill='url(#lens)'/>
  <path d='M34 19 L52 17 L52 21 L36 22 Z' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <path d='M56 17 L72 18 L70 22 L56 21 Z' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <path d='M38 17 L44 16' stroke='#8fb8ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M60 16 L66 16' stroke='#8fb8ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>

</svg>
